items.text: Patriots downgraded A.J. Brown to OUT for Sunday vs Dolphins due to knee (flared up, plus prior ankle). Confirmed by team and beat.
items.why: Knee issue flared; missed practices; official downgrade.
items.implication: NE WR targets redistribute; Drake Maye volume may shift to other pass-catchers; sit Brown.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining NE WRs and TE; Rhamondre Stevenson backfield secure.

items.text: Patriots ruled TreVeyon Henderson OUT (illness) for Sunday vs Dolphins; missed practices.
items.implication: Rhamondre Stevenson full backfield workload; handcuff elevated if needed.
items.opportunity: Stevenson carries/targets spike; goal-line/ dual-threat role locked.

items.text: Colts now open to trading Jonathan Taylor; talks ongoing and active (joint with Schefter).
items.why: Sources: Colts willing; active discussions pre-deadline.
items.implication: Hold; destination could boost/lower value; monitor.
items.opportunity: Potential new offense volume if traded.

items.text: RJ Harvey OUT (knee); unique role means no clean replacement but 3-6 extra targets available. Waddle also Q (chest).
items.why: Knee; ETR board and Levitan notes on role uniqueness.
items.implication: DEN backfield/ target distribution changes; monitor Waddle.
items.opportunity: 3-6 targets free; possible J.K. Dobbins or other RB/WR bump.

items.text: Shocked Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) not on final injury report; hard to believe 100% but playing/IN.
items.why: Absent from final report; ETR IN listing.
items.implication: Playing but possible limited efficiency/snaps; monitor usage.
items.opportunity: Full role if healthy; reverse prior backup beneficiaries.
items.conflict: Berry hates Barkley this week on usage concerns.

items.text: Breece Hall Q (quad) again; thought close last week but cryptic tweets + trade rumors. Cryptic faith post noted.
items.why: Quad; cryptic social + trade rumors; another Q tag.
items.implication: Uncertainty; Braelon Allen handcuff elevated if out.
items.conflict: Berry loves Hall/Allen combo vs LV.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka listed OUT (concussion, foot) on Sunday injury board; Levitan took him out of projections.
items.why: Concussion and foot; ETR/Levitan projections removed.
items.implication: TB WR targets open; sit Egbuka.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for other Bucs WRs.

items.text: Carnell Tate OUT (shoulder) per ETR Sunday board; Levitan projections updated with fallout.
items.why: Shoulder; official ETR OUT listing and proj removal.
items.implication: TEN WR depth chart shifts; targets free up.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed IN; not on final report though ankle pain noted as bearable. Small docks on rushing in projs.
items.why: Cleared final report; playing with manageable ankle pain.
items.implication: Full start expected; minor rushing dock possible.

items.text: After two-TD outing, sell Quinshon Judkins; role hit with Dylan Sampson back (season-low snaps/targets last week).
items.why: Passing-game role diminished post-Sampson return; sell-high after big game.
items.implication: Trade now; reduced target share expected ROS.
items.opportunity: Majority touches remain but pass work hit.
corroboration: Matthew Berry 10 Facts on Judkins role hit

items.text: Josh Jacobs going Ashton Jeanty route of strong fantasy value via high-value touches (3 inside-5 carries in 2 games post-suspension + 13 targets). Efficiency bonus.
items.why: Inside-5 carries and targets driving value despite efficiency questions (Jeanty parallel).
items.implication: Start with confidence; goal-line/ receiving work king.

items.text: Berry LOVES Zay Flowers (WR5) @ BUF; Lamar unlock + track-meet Bills-Ravens game.
items.why: Lamar back unlocks; high-scoring environment vs Bills.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry (RB6) @ BUF; history vs Buffalo and run-friendly matchup.
items.why: Favorable run defense matchup + prior success.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone work vs soft run D.

items.text: Berry HATES Saquon Barkley (RB20) @ WSH; usage concerns despite IN status.
items.why: Usage/role concerns (post-IR backdrop for others noted).
items.implication: Fade or lower expectations; possible limited work.
items.conflict: ETR/Levitan have him IN/playing; usage may not match full health assumption.
